messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person's whole outfit with the top, the bottoms, and the footwear, as shown from the front and back in the reference images. Keep only the clothing and footwear belonging to this target outfit, and leave all non-clothing aspects unchanged. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please go back to the video from before the first camera change was made, then use that video as the starting point for the following change: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the person's whole outfit with the top, the bottoms, and the footwear, as shown from the front and back in the reference images. Keep only the clothing and footwear belonging to this target outfit, and leave all non-clothing aspects unchanged. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands facing the camera, then turns and walks slowly to the right, ending with his back to the camera looking toward the water.","camera":"Full-body shot at eye level that pans right to follow the character as he turns and walks.","clothing":"White sleeveless tank top with a pink and purple palm-tree graphic, light turquoise shorts with white trim, and pink sneakers with white soles.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Short hair with a small ponytail at the back of the head.","identity":"A young Black male video-game character with a slim build and short facial hair.","scene":"A sunny outdoor dock or pier with stone paving, wooden crates, industrial buildings, and a body of water in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's plaid suit, shirt, tie, and black shoes were replaced by a white sleeveless tank top with a pink/purple palm-tree graphic, turquoise shorts with white trim, and pink sneakers. The character, hairstyle, body, scene, camera movement, and walking action remain consistent with the source.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the character's entire outfit with the reference outfit: white sleeveless tank top with pink/purple palm-tree graphic, turquoise shorts with white trim, and pink sneakers, while leaving non-clothing aspects unchanged.
uncertain: Fine details of the back graphic on the tank top are not clearly visible in the output, so exact match to the reference back view is uncertain.
